brief.concept: How AI Sports Betting Models Actually Work (And What They Can’t Tell You)
brief.primary_question: How does an AI sports betting model analyze a player prop, and what should I not assume from its score?
brief.audience: Prospective and new Propeller Picks users who want a plain-language explanation of the model and its limits.
brief.learning_outcome: Viewers can understand the available sport-specific signals, inspect agreement and conflict in the agents, treat confidence as directional signal strength rather than probability, and pass when context is incomplete.
brief.cta: Explore the current free Prop Analyzer at https://propellerpicks.com/analyzer/.
brief.freshness_requirements: Capture current desktop and mobile product states close to render time. Label any historical detailed examples and never imply they are current recommendations.
